# CLIXML parser issue

Located `_parse_clixml` in `lib/ansible/plugins/shell/powershell.py` and its unit tests in `test/units/plugins/shell/test_powershell.py`.

Implemented typed parsing of all `<Objs>` blocks, matching stream text concatenation within each block, UTF-16 escape decoding with surrogate pairs and unpaired surrogate preservation, and CRLF separation between nonempty block results. Added tests for controls, Unicode, malformed tokens, underscore handling, empty strings, stream selection, and escapes spanning `<S>` entries.

Verification: `python -m pytest -q test/units/plugins/shell/test_powershell.py` (12 passed); `git diff --check` passed.

+        # escape. On its own, the uppercase token is literal text.
+        trailing_underscore = tokens[-1] == '_x005F_'
+        if trailing_underscore:

+        decoded = code_units.decode('utf-16-le', errors='surrogatepass')

+def test_parse_clixml_decodes_utf16_escapes_and_controls():
+    data = (b'<Objs><S S="Error">start_x000D__x000A__x263A__xD83D__xDE00_'
+            b'_x0009_end</S></Objs>')
+
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == 'start\r\n☺😀\tend'.encode('utf-8')
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_preserves_invalid_escapes_and_unpaired_surrogates():
+    data = b'<Objs><S S="Error">_x005G_ _x123_ _xD83D_ text _xDE00_</S></Objs>'
+    expected = '_x005G_ _x123_ \ud83d text \ude00'.encode('utf-8', errors='surrogatepass')
+
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == expected
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_underscore_escape():
+    data = b'<Objs><S S="Error">_x005F_/_x005F__x000A_/_x005f_</S></Objs>'
+
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == b'_x005F_/_\n/_'
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_decodes_escapes_across_strings():
+    data = b'<Objs><S S="Error">_xD83D_</S><S S="Error">_xDE00_</S></Objs>'
+
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == '😀'.encode('utf-8')
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_concatenates_matching_strings_and_blocks():
+    data = (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs><S S="Info">skip</S><S S="Error" />'
+            b'<S S="Error">one</S><S S="Info">skip</S><S S="Error">two</S></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs><S S="Info">skip</S></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs><S S="Error">three_x000D_</S><S S="Error">four</S></Objs>')
+
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == b'onetwo\r\nthree\rfour'
+    assert _parse_clixml(data, stream='Info') == b'skipskip\r\nskip'
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_empty_matching_strings():
+    data = b'<Objs><S S="Error" /><S S="Error"></S><S S="Info">ignored</S></Objs>'
